translations.launcher.help:
HyperAgent command format

Use the Claude-Code-like launcher:
  HyperAgent "analyze the latest HSI result and propose the next experiment"
  HyperAgent
  HyperAgent chat "continue this research session"
  HyperAgent run --loop-mode cache-first "inspect reports and decide the next action"
  HyperAgent plan "implement an ablation config generator"
  HyperAgent act "inspect reports and choose the next safe command"

Slash-style aliases:
  HyperAgent /status
  HyperAgent /sessions
  HyperAgent /resume <session_id> "continue from here"
  HyperAgent /compact <session_id> --keep-last 4
  HyperAgent /model
  HyperAgent /reasonix
  HyperAgent /usage
  HyperAgent /cost
  HyperAgent /events
  HyperAgent /stats
  HyperAgent /commands
  HyperAgent /todos
  HyperAgent /doctor
  HyperAgent /web
  HyperAgent /image
  HyperAgent /ide-context
  HyperAgent /plan-mode
  HyperAgent /worktree
  HyperAgent /mcp
  HyperAgent /skills
  HyperAgent /prompts
  HyperAgent /channels
  HyperAgent /language
  HyperAgent /tui
  HyperAgent /repl

Inside REPL:
  /context, /compact, /clear, /usage, /cost, /stats, /budget, /pro, /skill, /checkpoint, /restore, /logs, /init, /memory, /agents, /agents run, /commands, /todos, /hooks, /permissions, /export, /doctor, /plugin, /rewind, /reasonix, /btw, /simplify, /thinking, /web, /image, /ide-context, /plan-mode, /feedback, /worktree, /mcp status

Provider options can be mixed into prompt commands:
  HyperAgent --model deepseek-v4-pro --thinking enabled --reasoning-effort max "design the next experiment"
  HyperAgent --reasonix-profile reasonix-deep "diagnose the failed experiment"
  HyperAgent send --model deepseek-v4-flash --json-output "return a JSON plan"

Canonical commands remain available:
  HyperAgent demo --synthetic
  HyperAgent command-list
  HyperAgent command-render --name feature-dev --arguments "add a reviewer"
  HyperAgent events --limit 20
  HyperAgent stats
  HyperAgent checkpoint --path hyperagent/runtime/action_loop.py
  HyperAgent index --root hyperagent
  HyperAgent web status
  HyperAgent image status
  HyperAgent run-suite --config configs/experiment.yaml --seeds 42,43,44
  HyperAgent channel-run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
translations.repl.help:
HyperAgent REPL commands:
/help                 show commands
/status               show workspace status
/session              show current session
/btw <question>       ask an isolated temporary question
/sessions             list sessions
/new [title]          create a new session
/resume <session_id>  switch session
/context              show context compression status
/usage [limit]        summarize LLM usage and cache-hit ledger
/cost [limit]         show token/cost ledger
/stats                summarize events and LLM usage
/retry                retry the previous plain-text user message
/stop                 report active request status
/copy [path]          export current session for terminal copy
/compact [keep_last]  compress current session
/clear                clear current context after saving a rewind snapshot
/init                 create project HyperAgent.md memory
/memory ...           list/show/add memory entries
/agents ...           list/add/run project subagents
/commands ...         list/render Markdown slash commands
/todos ...            list/clear/export TodoWrite state
/hooks ...            list/add/enable/disable/test project hooks
/permissions          show current permission policy and session grants
/export [path]        export current session as Markdown
/doctor               run a local workspace self-check
/plugin ...           list/add project plugins
/rewind [save]        list or save rewind snapshots
/reasonix [profile]   show DeepSeek Reasonix-inspired profiles
/preset ...           list or set Reasonix-style runtime preset
/pro                  arm reasonix-deep + cache-first mode
/budget [tokens|off]  show or set action-loop token budget
/thinking ...         expand/collapse model reasoning_content display
/simplify             show the three-agent simplification council
/model                list LLM providers
/ide-context ...      manage manually supplied IDE context
/mcp ...              list/check MCP servers
/personality ...      show/update local interaction personality note
/feedback ...         record/list local feedback notes
/plan-mode ...        toggle plan-only mode
/web ...              search/fetch public web through controlled tools
/image ...            create image request artifacts
/worktree             show git worktree status
/skill ...            list/show/run skills
/checkpoint ...       list or create file checkpoints
/restore <id>         restore a checkpoint
/jobs                 show background job status
/logs [limit]         show recent runtime events
/tools                list local tools
/tool ...             run a local tool with permission policy
/plan <instruction>   generate a coding/algorithm plan
/act <instruction>    run controlled LLM tool loop
/exit                 quit
Plain text sends a persistent agent-chat turn.
